trigger: Three claude-code-session subagents in a dsh ptc-preset session ended with UNSUPPORTED_INPUT 'An image in a trailing mid-turn user message is not supported.' after an image was loaded inside run_code.
transport: official Agent SDK 0.3.322 streaming input; Claude Code CLI 2.1.322

probe.purpose: Find whether an image in a trailing user message reaches the model when the message arrives while an MCP tool handler is parked.
probe.base: the issue #4 trailing-context probe, with the trailing text replaced by one text block and one base64 PNG block
probe.image: synthetic 480x160 PNG, 8072 bytes, showing the word QUOKKA58
probe.trailing_text: TRAILING_MARKER_9Q: after the token, also write the exact word that is shown in the attached image.
probe.case: before_release: push the trailing message on the streaming input queue, wait 800 ms, then release the tool result

capture_method.primary: The official CLI diagnostic OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES wrote each raw request body to a private file directory.

request_after_tool_result.note: The recorded body is a thread delta.
user_message_blocks: tool_result with the text TOOL_TOKEN_7Q only
text: <system-reminder> The user sent a new message while you were working: TRAILING_MARKER_9Q ... (CLI-generated wrapper)
image: image/png, base64 length 10764 (the complete 8072-byte file)
request_after_tool_result.system_message: CLI token-budget note, no trailing content

change_from_2026_11_11: With CLI 2.1.319 the trailing text was in a separate system-role message. With CLI 2.1.322 the CLI puts the wrapper text and the image as blocks of the user message that holds the tool_result, after that block.
conclusion: An image in a trailing mid-turn user message, queued before the result release, reaches the model in the same native turn and the same request as the tool result.
The CLI keeps the image as its own block after the tool_result block. This matches the dsh native message order: a tool result, then a separate user message with the image.
The adapter can deliver a trailing image through the existing mid-turn input path. It does not need to fold the image into the tool result.
not_proven: The plugin inside an installed dsh profile; this probe used the SDK directly.
Several trailing images or several trailing messages with images in one boundary.
The after-release order with an image.
Signed-thinking retention across a mid-turn message.
Behavior on another CLI or SDK version. CLI 2.1.319 put trailing text in another place.
